pod.raw: The Spanish Armada lands its army in England in 1588
pod.statement: The Spanish Armada lands its army in England in 1588.
pod.baselineContext: In the attested record of 1588, Europe stood at a hinge: thrones, levies, and alliances were being renegotiated by force and marriage alike. The divergence bends the Spanish Armada. The divergence departs from that settled course.

eras.title: Two Years of Aftermath
eras.summary: Two years of consequences arrive in the order consequences always do: first prices, then postures, then paperwork. The great structures hold; their assumptions do not.
eras.detail:
Two years of consequences arrive in the order consequences always do: first prices, then postures, then paperwork. The great structures hold; their assumptions do not. The span from 1588 to 1590 reads, in retrospect, as one argument conducted in many registers: what would the ordinary strains of a changed world be allowed to cost, and who would pay it.

The record answers through its events. A different order signed (1588); The Académie des sciences convenes over the changed course (Later that year, 1588); Salt prices shift in the Paris markets (Spring 1589). Each was a partial discharge of the same accumulated pressure, none a settlement. As usual, the porters and clerks knew first, and were consulted last.

By 1590 the question had not been answered so much as re-priced. What the era settled, it settled in habits and ledgers rather than treaties; what it left loaded, the next era would inherit with interest.

events.title: A different order signed
events.summary: The Spanish Armada lands its army in England in 1588. Paris takes the news the way ports take weather: schedules shift before opinions do, and the harbormaster knows before the council does.

deltas.note: The immediate shock is absorbed; the accounting begins.

plausibility.rationale: Direct restatement of the divergence itself; the least contingent claim in the timeline.

events.title: The Académie des sciences convenes over the changed course
events.summary: The Académie des sciences meets in extraordinary session. Marie-Anne Lefevre argues that the moment must be committed to record before rumor rewrites it; a survey of holdings, obligations, and precedents is ordered.

deltas.note: The institution claims the divergence as its business.
Responsibility, and visibility, attach to the one who asked for the record.

plausibility.rationale: Institutions reliably respond to discontinuity with procedure; the specific convenor is the contingent part.

events.title: Salt prices shift in the Paris markets
events.summary: The first measurable consequence arrives where it always does: in prices. Salt moves against last season's rate in Paris, and porters, brokers, and household stewards adjust before any council does.

deltas.note: The exchequer notices what the market already knew.

plausibility.rationale: Price adjustment is the most reliable early transmission channel of any structural change.

events.title: The Habsburg court recalculates
events.summary: Reports reaching the Habsburg court force a quiet revision of plans laid under the old assumptions. Envoys are reassigned, an inventory is taken, and a policy that had seemed settled is reopened, without any public admission that anything has changed.

deltas.note: The rival’s settled policy quietly goes back to committee.

plausibility.rationale: Neighbors always reprice risk after a discontinuity; the two-year lag matches the speed of credible intelligence.

events.title: The markets reprice around the Kingdom of France
events.summary: The story The Habsburg court tells about itself has not been updated for the new circumstances; someone will update it first. Brokers adjust before any edict: contracts shorten, surety costs rise, and household stewards change what they store. (social reading)

deltas.note: The market hedges; kitchens follow.

plausibility.rationale: Price adjustment is the most reliable transmission channel of structural pressure.

events.title: A working technique crosses the Habsburg court's border
events.summary: What the Académie des sciences kept close now travels with journeymen. Two lean years in the districts around The Habsburg court would exhaust the granary math. (social reading)

deltas.note: Knowledge proves cheaper to hire than to guard.
A new name starts appearing in the registers.

plausibility.rationale: Techniques diffuse along wage gradients; guarding them raises the wage.

events.title: The Académie des sciences revises what the young are taught
events.summary: Over the following season the old arrangement gives way. A new syllabus fixes the changed world into schoolroom fact. Too much of what The Habsburg court eats and sells moves along a single corridor that others can tax or close. Children now learn as ordinary what their grandparents called impossible. (social reading)

deltas.note: The syllabus quietly rewrites what counts as common knowledge.

plausibility.rationale: Institutions metabolize discontinuity into curriculum within a generation. Revised after review: the mechanism is now named instead of asserted.

artifacts.title: Letter of Marie-Anne Lefevre on the académie des sciences convenes over the changed course

paragraphs: You will have heard some version of it by now, so let me give you the true one before rumor improves it further. The Académie des sciences meets in extraordinary session. Marie-Anne Lefevre argues that the moment must be committed to record before rumor rewrites it; a survey of holdings, obligations, and precedents is ordered.

What it means for us: the salt contracts must be re-sworn, and I would not extend credit past the season until we see how the Académie des sciences settles. Aunt Zoe asks after your health and whether the northern road is safe; I have told her yes to the first and lied about the second.
Send word by the first reliable carrier. And send the account-book. The real one.
body.postscript: P.S. The price of candles has doubled. Draw your own conclusions about how late the council is sitting.

paragraphs: The Spanish Armada lands its army in England in 1588. Paris takes the news the way ports take weather: schedules shift before opinions do, and the harbormaster knows before the council does.

Those closest to the affair counsel patience; those furthest from it, as usual, counsel everything else. The Académie des sciences is said to be preparing an accounting, which is what it is always said to be preparing.

paragraphs: Prices answered before opinions did. Dealers in salt report the season's contracts rewritten twice in a fortnight, and the porters, who always know first, have raised their rates.
It is meanwhile reported that position=well-placed observer; reputation=rising.

courtRecords.advocate: The advocate submits that "Marie-Anne Lefevre attempts the grand reconciliation" stands within the record given: its cited causes are live in the world-state, its scale is modest for the era, and the objection mistakes an unfamiliar outcome for an unearned one. Histories of this dial are permitted to surprise; they are not permitted to float, and this event does not float.
courtRecords.skeptic: The skeptic answers that "Marie-Anne Lefevre attempts the grand reconciliation" asks its causes to carry more than they weigh: the cited chain establishes opportunity, not outcome, and the world-state shows no actor with both the means and the appetite. Absent an intermediate step, the event is an assertion wearing a date.

ruling.opinion: The court cannot reconcile the briefs: the causes neither carry "Marie-Anne Lefevre attempts the grand reconciliation" nor exclude it. The event is kept on the ledger under a visible dispute, with this record attached.

interpretations.gloss: Read the accounts and "The Kingdom of France reorders its accounts under doctrinal quarrel" stops being a decision at all. The money had already moved; what the chronicles record as a choice is the moment somebody finally wrote down an arrangement that had been operating for two seasons. Our rivals want a villain here. We have a ledger, and the ledger balances.

"The Kingdom of France reorders its accounts under doctrinal quarrel" happened because three people in one room preferred it to the alternative in front of them, and the alternative in front of them was not the one posterity imagines. The Ledger School will tell you the money decided. The money was available for either course. Somebody chose.

The registers show the change arriving in the district a full generation before "The Kingdom of France reorders its accounts under doctrinal quarrel" is supposed to have caused it: fewer apprentices bound, more women in the trades, the old feast quietly dropped. What the assembly did that year was ratify a fact. The event is a date the capital gave to something the country had already finished doing.
